artifact_scope: five low-fidelity planning wireframes and shared shell annotations; no production UI

unstored_secret_lease_contract.deadline: earlier of the action timeout and acquisition plus 60 seconds
unstored_secret_lease_contract.cleanup: Release all lease-owned references and copies; overwrite lease-owned mutable buffers where practical.
unstored_secret_lease_contract.copy_limitation: Swift String/Data plus driver/runtime copies provide only best-effort lifetime cleanup; no guaranteed zeroization is claimed.

cancellation_race_contract.serialization: One ConnectionAttempt actor serializes every lease, authentication/session, cancellation, connection-close and terminal-error event under one attempt ID.
accepted_cancel_order: revoke the credential lease and deny all later access
cancellation_race_contract.authentication_success_before_cancel: Attempt remains succeeded; revoke the lease before publishing Connected, and a later cancel cannot rewrite the terminal attempt outcome.
cancellation_race_contract.cancel_before_authentication_success: Later success is stale; never publish Connected, close any created session, and await the first valid terminal event.
cancellation_race_contract.explicit_driver_acknowledgement: Cancellation outcome becomes confirmed; only this path permits a Cancelled attempt outcome.
cancellation_race_contract.connection_closed_before_confirmation: Cancellation outcome becomes connectionClosed and attempt/execution outcome is unknown unless stronger adapter evidence exists.
cancellation_race_contract.typed_error_before_confirmation: Attempt outcome remains Failed with its typed authentication, transport or execution error; do not relabel it as Cancelled.
cancellation_race_contract.unsupported_cancellation: Fail or close the attempt without reusing or reacquiring the revoked lease; never report Cancelled.
cancellation_race_contract.teardown_deadline: Cancellation remains unconfirmed and the attempt reports timeout/unconfirmed teardown without a Connected state.
cancellation_race_contract.repeated_cancel: Idempotent; it cannot duplicate driver cancellation or rewrite a terminal outcome.
cancellation_race_contract.stale_callback: Ignore a late callback or wrong attempt ID after cleanup, except that an attached late session must be closed.
cancellation_race_contract.terminal_invariant: Exactly one monotonic terminal attempt outcome; lease access stays denied after revocation.

required_tests: revoke before visible cancellation announcement and driver forwarding
late successful session is never exposed and is closed
repeated cancel and stale or wrong-attempt callback handling
unsupported cancellation cannot reuse or reacquire the revoked lease
teardown deadline remains unconfirmed rather than falsely cancelled
seeded-canary scan across logs, diagnostics and retained state

shared_contract_review.evidence: Window, toolbar and status regions repeat connection/environment in text; color and icon are supplementary.
shared_contract_review.milestone_verification: M1 shared shell, then each owning M2 flow: accessibility tree and screenshot/semantic tests in Light/Dark and Differentiate Without Color.

shared_contract_review.evidence: Sidebar, document, inspector and bottom panel are independently resizable; safety text reflows and pane collapse preserves logical focus.
shared_contract_review.gap: No executable minimum-size, collapse-priority, localized expansion or focus-preservation evidence exists.
shared_contract_review.milestone_verification: M1 shared shell and owning M2 flows: minimum/current window matrix, pseudo-localization and focus-preservation UI tests.

shared_contract_review.evidence: Primary and reverse region order plus initial, modal return, error, async and collapsed-region transitions are specified; a visible focus ring is required.
shared_contract_review.gap: No actual responder chain, keyboard event or per-control focus-restoration evidence exists.
shared_contract_review.milestone_verification: M1 shared shell and owning M2 flows: deterministic forward/reverse keyboard walkthrough and focus-restoration assertions.

shared_contract_review.evidence: Named regions and coalesced busy/empty/error/cancelling/partial/unknown announcements are required without stealing focus.
shared_contract_review.gap: Detailed roles/values/actions, logical grid/editor semantics, error navigation and manual VoiceOver behavior are not executable evidence.
shared_contract_review.milestone_verification: M1 shell/profile views and owning M2 editor/grid/safety flows: AX role/name/value/action assertions plus manual VoiceOver navigation.

shared_contract_review.evidence: Command palette, menu command and accessible label parity are declared for toolbar actions.
shared_contract_review.milestone_verification: At each owning milestone, menu, toolbar, palette and shortcut invoke one application intent and the same safeguard path.

shared_contract_review.evidence: Light/Dark, Increase Contrast, Differentiate Without Color and Reduce Motion are named gates; text/icon/shape and motion-independent state are required.
shared_contract_review.gap: No palette-token, contrast, native rendering or system-setting runtime evidence exists.
shared_contract_review.milestone_verification: M1 shared components and each owning M2 flow: appearance matrix, contrast calculations, non-color traits and reduced-motion semantic-state tests.

wireframes.title: Empty workspace and restoration
accepted: First focus on New connection.
Empty message is a heading and actions have keyboard equivalents.
Restored drafts remain disconnected and nothing auto-runs.
Missing non-secret reference has a repair action; no credential or transaction restoration.
milestone_verification: Fresh launch forward/reverse focus order.
Restored/missing-reference focus and VoiceOver announcement.
Warm restore remains interactive within the performance budget.
Pseudo-localized buttons/headings fit or reflow at minimum window size.

wireframes.title: Connection and trust form
accepted: Fields are capability-driven.

Authentication method and Keychain storage choice are distinct; unstored secrets use the provisional sole-owner, 60-second/action-deadline, revocation and best-effort-cleanup contract and do not enter drafts.
Current direct mode reports TLS/hostname failures; SSH/host-key phases remain absent until an exact capability is adopted and configured.
Production selection uses persistent text and the keyboard path cannot bypass confirmation.
wireframes.verification_milestone: M1 non-live profile UI; M2 live connection and trust
milestone_verification: Unsupported SSH controls absent or disabled with an explicit explanation.
Authentication method and credential-storage controls have separate programmatic labels, help and error associations.
Direct test connection omits SSH/host-key phases; any future adopted and configured SSH mode adds only its truthful phases.
Test connection phases and cancellation announce without exposing or persisting an unstored credential; fake-clock and trigger/race tests prove lease revocation and denied use after revoke.
Production selection reaches the same confirmation by mouse and keyboard.

wireframes.title: Query editor, result stream and grid
accepted: Connection/schema/transaction/read-only context remains visible.
Cancel Query immediately becomes Cancelling; cancellation and execution outcomes remain separate and report driver truth.
Grid differentiates NULL, empty and not-loaded with non-color fallbacks.
Theme changes preserve selection, scroll and pending edits.
milestone_verification: Cancel Query menu/toolbar/Command-Period parity, <=100 ms visible cancelling state and requested/confirmed/connectionClosed/unsupported mapping.
Cancelled execution appears only after confirmation; connectionClosed remains outcome unknown without stronger evidence.
Initial fetch limit and loaded/available counts are unambiguous.
Editor and logical grid AX roles, headers, selection, loading, sort and deferred-value semantics.
Light/Dark/contrast/non-color/theme invalidation on BF-02/BF-03 fixtures.
Keyboard traversal skips virtualized offscreen cells without materializing the dataset.

wireframes.title: Production destructive confirmation
accepted: Production target, risk, consequence, transaction behavior and immutable SQL preview are textual.
Typed target confirmation and preview revalidation are mandatory.
VoiceOver announces the risk and disabled reason.
Keyboard shortcuts enter the same safeguard and color is supplementary.
milestone_verification: Initial focus is the consequence heading or safest review control, never Apply.
Exact full preview identity/digest and stale reason are programmatically available.
Typed token cannot be pasted/replayed across a changed target or preview.
Long engine/object/localized consequence text reflows without hiding target or Apply state.

wireframes.title: Transaction and pending-edit close protection
accepted: Keep tab open is the first/safest action and Escape keeps work open.
Close never commits and rollback is offered only when supported.
Unknown outcomes lead to read-only reconciliation, not retry.
Transaction ID, target and pending count are textual and VoiceOver-visible.
milestone_verification: Default, Escape and Return cannot trigger discard, commit or unknown close.
Unknown-outcome close requires a separate explicit acknowledgement bound to transaction/target.
Lost connection and unsupported rollback update available actions without moving focus to a dangerous action.
Multiple-tab app termination preserves per-target consequence and keyboard navigation.

findings.finding: The initial WF-02 visually showed SSH and known-host controls although ADR-0012/0015 keep SSH unavailable.
findings.required_change: Make the default artifact omit the row or show a non-interactive Unsupported — no SSH implementation adopted state; omit SSH phases and host-key errors until an exact capability is both adopted and configured.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: applied; WF-02 shows an explicit non-interactive unsupported state and current direct test/connect paths omit SSH and host-key phases
findings.revisit_trigger: A future SSH ADR adopts an exact implementation after all re-entry gates.

findings.finding: Abbreviations such as TLS/CA lacked expanded labels, and the initial Authentication [Keychain] control confused database authentication method with credential storage.
findings.required_change: Use expanded transport labels; separate authentication method from Keychain storage; bind field errors and consequence/help text; for an unstored secret define one ConnectionAttempt owner, the earlier-of-action-timeout-or-60-second deadline, no renewal, all cancel/success/failure/error/close/deadline revocation triggers, denied use after revoke, and best-effort cleanup without a guaranteed-zeroization claim.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: applied at wireframe-contract level; executable label/error/storage behavior remains owning M1/M2 evidence
findings.revisit_trigger: Before M1-002/M1-004 UI copy is frozen.

findings.finding: The initial Stop label was visually paired with Command-Period but did not freeze menu/accessibility wording or terminal truth states.
findings.required_change: Name the action Cancel Query in menu/AX help, keep visible Cancelling, report requested/confirmed/connectionClosed/unsupported cancellation outcome, and report execution outcome separately; only confirmed may produce Cancelled.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: applied; executable state mapping remains M2 evidence
findings.revisit_trigger: When the M2 cancellation state model is reviewed.

findings.finding: The initial rows [200] label could mean page size, initial fetch limit or hard row limit, creating an unsafe/incorrect expectation about large results.
findings.required_change: Label the exact policy (for example Initial fetch limit: 200) and separately expose loaded count, limit reached and explicit Load more/stream export choices.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: applied; server/result implementation evidence remains M2
findings.revisit_trigger: Before M2 result streaming and grid UI implementation.

findings.finding: Region order is present, but modal entry/return, async completion, error focus, collapsed panes, reverse traversal and restored-tab focus are not fully specified.
findings.required_change: Add a focus-transition table for each flow, including safest default, Escape/Return, error summary, initiating-control return and hidden-region behavior.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: shared focus lifecycle added; executable per-control proof remains M1
findings.revisit_trigger: Before M1-002 shell state/API design is accepted.

findings.finding: Annotations name regions and announcements but do not freeze roles, values, actions, coalescing or manual navigation evidence.
findings.required_change: Add AX contract rows per control/state and require automated AX assertions plus manual VoiceOver walkthrough; metadata-only tests cannot claim VoiceOver pass.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: announcement/coalescing contract clarified; detailed AX rows and manual evidence remain open
findings.revisit_trigger: When executable M1 shell/profile and M2 editor/grid/safety views and test identifiers exist.

findings.finding: The artifact names appearance modes but supplies no tokens, contrast ratios or system-setting screenshots/semantic snapshots.
findings.required_change: Define semantic system colors/tokens later, verify 4.5:1 ordinary text, and preserve text/icon/tooltips under Increase Contrast and Differentiate Without Color.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: semantic/non-color rule clarified; palette evidence remains open
findings.revisit_trigger: When M1 theme tokens are proposed; never infer a pass from monochrome ASCII.

findings.finding: Long localized production, transaction, error and action text has no expansion/reflow decision.
findings.required_change: Define wrapping/truncation priority; never truncate target/consequence/transaction/disabled reason; run pseudo-localization and right-to-left layout review where supported.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: wrapping/truncation priority added; pseudo-localized executable evidence remains open
findings.revisit_trigger: Before localized M1 UI snapshots and minimum-size acceptance.

findings.finding: The initial Close and acknowledge unknown outcome action was too easy to reach and did not define a transaction/target-bound acknowledgement.
findings.required_change: Move it behind a separate consequence step with explicit target/transaction acknowledgement; it is never default, Return, Escape or adjacent to the safest action without spacing/grouping.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: applied as a separate ellipsis action and explicit second-step contract; executable proof remains open
findings.revisit_trigger: Before transaction-close flow can be approved for M1/M2 implementation.

findings.finding: The initial abbreviated visual digest 8F… did not define what identity is announced, copied or compared.
findings.required_change: Expose a short human label plus programmatically available full digest/target/SQL identity and an explicit stale reason; never ask users to validate cryptography manually.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: applied at wireframe-contract level; domain/AX implementation remains open
findings.revisit_trigger: When the destructive-preview domain contract is defined.

findings.finding: Only pane animation is mentioned; loading/cancelling/progress and focus transitions could still rely on motion.
findings.required_change: Disable decorative transitions and retain text/progress semantics; motion must never be the sole busy/cancel indicator.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: applied at shared-contract level; executable appearance test remains open
findings.revisit_trigger: When M1 animation/progress components are selected.

findings.finding: The artifact references Dynamic Type but does not define macOS text-size behavior, clipping policy or zoom/text settings interaction.
findings.required_change: Use system text styles where appropriate, support accessibility display/text settings, and test long/larger text without hiding safety actions or fixed-size breakage.
findings.artifact_resolution_status: minimum text/reflow safety contract added; executable typography evidence remains open
findings.revisit_trigger: Before M1 minimum-window and typography tokens are accepted.

accepted_safety_invariants: No wireframe calls a database, driver or Keychain API.
Restoration never auto-runs a query, reconnects a session or restores a transaction.
Production, read-only, transaction, target and cancellation context use text; color is supplementary.
Keyboard commands enter the same safety/application intent as pointer controls.
Destructive apply revalidates target/SQL/capability/read-only state and the canonical preview digest.
Close never silently commits and connection loss never becomes an automatic retry.
Unsupported capabilities are absent or explicitly explained, never presented as working.
NULL, empty and not-loaded remain semantically distinct.

review_checklist.requirement: Product, macOS interaction design, Accessibility/VoiceOver, Database Safety and Security disposition the hierarchy, terminology and safeguards
review_checklist.evidence: Engineering review identifies concrete terminology revisions and no competitor copying.

review_checklist.requirement: Owning M1/M2 tests cover focus/menu/shortcut/VoiceOver/appearance/motion for their executable flows
review_checklist.evidence: Test intents are enumerated; repository has no production UI/test target.
UX-005/008/012 define owners and required owning M1/M2 evidence.
Only documentation and machine-readable review evidence are produced.

not_tested: No AppKit/SwiftUI view, accessibility tree, keyboard event, VoiceOver session, palette, localized bundle or window resizing exists to execute.
No xcodebuild, UI test, snapshot or Instruments run is possible without a separately authorized production scaffold and full Xcode.
ASCII wireframes cannot prove contrast, visual hierarchy, clipping, frame rate or native control semantics.
No Product, macOS interaction design, Accessibility/VoiceOver, Database Safety or Security reviewer has signed the artifact.
safe_next_step: Obtain explicit dispositions from Product, macOS interaction design, Accessibility/VoiceOver, Database Safety and Security; keep M1 and M2 production UI unauthorized until separate implementation requests and owning milestone gates exist.
